key_stat: Subsidiary of Banca March | Securities services | Fund platform
summary: Banco Inversis is a Spanish securities services bank, subsidiary of Banca March. Provides custody, fund distribution, securities clearing and settlement, and technology platforms for financial institutions. Key player in Spanish fund distribution market. Serves banks, wealth managers, and insurance companies as an infrastructure provider. Technology-intensive business model: platforms for fund distribution, custody, and post-trade services.
